backend_router.note: Populated in Phase 4. Intended contract: router/failover.py reads todo_queue above, finds the first entry with status=pending and all depends_on marked done, and dispatches it to whichever backend responds first from the list below.

handoff_protocol.rule: Any model resuming this build reads ARK-STATE.json first, finds the lowest-numbered todo_queue entry with status=pending and satisfied depends_on, executes it, then updates that entry's status plus updated_at/updated_by before stopping.
